subject: Action needed: VAT ID mismatch blocking supplier payout
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <accounts@cloudsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Nguyen <procurement@cloudsync.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:14:00 +0000
Subject: Payment hold - VAT ID mismatch on invoice INV-202610-125

Hi Marissa,

We're seeing a payment hold on invoice INV-202610-125 (EUR) — your AP team reached out saying the invoice VAT ID doesn't match CloudSync's VAT record in the EU registry and the payout team needs confirmation before releasing funds. We've attached the invoice and our supplier VAT certificate for reference.

Can Redwood confirm whether the invoice should be treated under reverse-charge (CloudSync is B2B in DE) or if there was a transcription error on the VAT number? This payment is time-sensitive — the vendor requires payment by Nov 12 to avoid service disruption.

Attachments: CloudSync_INV-202610-125.pdf, CloudSync_VAT_Certificate_2026.pdf

Thanks,
Sarah Lim
Accounts Payable
CloudSync Ltd.
attachments: 2 files
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <accounts@cloudsync.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold - VAT ID mismatch on invoice INV-202610-125

Sarah — thanks for flagging this. I've looped in Rishi (finance) and Ben (sales ops) to triage. Quick answers below, and next steps at the bottom.

Prelim check: the VAT number on the invoice (DE123456789) does not match the VAT registration CloudSync provided earlier (DE123456788). That one-digit difference explains the registry lookup failure.

Questions for you:
- Can you confirm whether CloudSync expects Redwood to apply reverse-charge (we invoice Nett, CloudSync self-account for VAT) OR if they require a VAT-inclusive invoice?
- If the VAT on file is the correct one (DE123456788), can you resend a signed VAT attestation?

Proposed next steps (fast path to lift hold):
1) If CloudSync confirms they are B2B in Germany and reverse-charge applies, we will: mark invoice as RC-exempt and authorize payout after a one-off reconciliation.
2) If Redwood made a transcription error, we will reissue a corrected invoice (INV-202610-125R) the same day and route to your AP for payment.

Rishi — can you advise whether we can clear the hold under our RC exception policy if CloudSync provides the VAT cert? Ben — if we reissue, I need a quick confirmation that reissue won't break the existing ordering/PO flow.

Marissa Cole
Finance Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Lim <accounts@cloudsync.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold - VAT ID mismatch on invoice INV-202610-125

Marissa / Sarah — short update from finance.

- If CloudSync is a DE-registered business and we have their valid VAT certificate on file, we can treat the invoice as reverse-charge and release payment. Our policy requires either: VIES-confirmed VAT ID match OR a supplied government-issued VAT certificate for edge cases (document attached by Sarah).
- Given the one-digit difference Sarah noted, please have CloudSync confirm which is correct. If they confirm DE123456788 (their certificate), mark the invoice as RC and we'll release.

If CloudSync cannot provide a certificate within the next 24 hours, we will need a reissued invoice with the corrected VAT number (we can accept a reissue with reference INV-202610-125R). Finance can fast-track release once the reissued invoice is uploaded to our portal and matched to the PO.

I'll authorize a one-time exception to the standard 72-hour waiting period provided the certificate or corrected invoice is received by end of day Nov 10.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Financial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Nguyen <procurement@cloudsync.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <accounts@cloudsync.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold - VAT ID mismatch on invoice INV-202610-125

Hi all — following up with confirmation. Apologies — that was a copy/paste error on our side. The correct VAT is DE123456788 (matches attached certificate). We've uploaded the signed VAT attestation to the portal and reattached the certificate here.

We confirm CloudSync is a B2B registered entity in Germany and requests reverse-charge treatment for this invoice. Please proceed to mark INV-202610-125 as RC and release payment. If you need a reissued invoice for your AP workflow, let us know — we can accept the payment either way as long as accounting clears.

Attachments: CloudSync_VAT_Certificate_2026.pdf

Thanks for the quick turnaround,
Daniel Nguyen
Procurement Lead
CloudSync Ltd.
